snippet.title: The Most Beautiful MMORPG That Was Left to Die
snippet.description:
Ninelives is an MMORPG that was never completed, but it saw enough of a single player version for me to become obsessed with the game. I realised that I was searching for this kind of art direction and experience for years, only stumbling across this abandoned game world by chance a few months ago. Join me as I discuss the game and my journey with it!

Thank you to Tota (SmokymonkeyS) for the interview which you can read in full here:
https://www.tumblr.com/eurothug4000/769143171595862017/interview-on-the-making-of-the-cancelled-mmorpg?source=share

You can find SmokymonkeyS and their games here:
http://www.smokymonkeys.com/kyrill/index.asp
https://ninelives.smokymonkeys.com/

Tangomushi's Garage video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=joQ34j3miLs

Big thanks to @pimscrypt for the guest voiceover!
Thank you to RudeCanine for the voiceover mixing, @hotcyder  for the thumbnail and AdamLane4 for script proofing! And thanks to @geoh3x  for the end animation!
